name: Colonies of Benevolence
description: In the early 1800s, reformers tried to solve urban poverty by moving poor families, orphans and beggars onto farmland in remote corners of the Netherlands and Belgium. Frederiksoord, Wilhelminaoord and Veenhuizen in the Netherlands, and Wortel in Belgium, still show the plan: straight tree-lined avenues, small family farms, and huge dormitories where "unfree" residents worked under guards.
